title: 第3章 意外的委托第4章 第一站黑魔森林
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 林鬼并未料到，店长的委托仅仅只是一个开端。
当他穿梭于各家店铺购置远行物资时。
关于他接下“信鸽“委托的消息，已如野火般，传遍了大街小巷。
贫民窟里的人们交头接耳，眼中闪烁着难以置信的光芒。
新约城，城主府。
听完下属的详尽汇报。
身着锦缎华服、指尖轻敲着名贵木桌的城主皱起了眉头。
书房内烛光摇曳，映照着他阴晴不定的脸。
“你是说，那个叫林鬼的流浪法师，去过魔法都市，还全身而退了？“
他的声音里带着一丝难以置信的探究。
十年间，野外的恶魔数量激增。
派出去探查的卫士和冒险家，十个人里能回来一个就不错了。
单单新约城外的黑魔森林，自己手下最强大的骑士都没办法穿越。
声称，必须有超凡强者护送，才勉强能穿过。
他，一个流浪孩起家的卑贱魔法师，是怎么做到的？
而且还是万里之外的魔法都市？
“千真万确，城主大人。“
下属恭敬地回答。
“一年前拍卖会上，那盏拍出天价的永明水晶灯，就是他从魔法都市带回来的，守卫长亲眼所见。“
城主的视线，掠过桌上，那盏正流淌着柔和瑰丽光晕的魔法灯具，指尖停顿，缓缓点了点头。
那盏灯确实非凡，蕴含的魔法工艺让新约最好的铁匠，为之迷恋。
“他的实力，评估如何？“
“据冒险者公会观察，他应是高阶下位法师，精通风与土的元素之力。”
“实力......没有人能准确知道，因为没有人见过他战斗的场景。"
"依属下看，或许仅比防卫军团长大人稍逊半筹。“
城主拖长了语调，身体微微前倾，显露出兴趣。
一个能与团长媲美的高阶法师，在整个新约城都是凤毛麟角。
“是否需要属下带人前去，请他接下护送小姐前往卡兰城的任务？“
下属谨慎地询问，特意加重了“请“字。
城主从鼻子里发出一声轻蔑的冷哼。
“将我珍贵的明珠托付给一个贫民出身的流浪法师？绝无可能。“
他顿了顿，尽管对方的出身让他本能地排斥，但女儿的行程确已迫在眉睫。
为了他们家族的延续，卡兰城那边的联姻不能再拖了。
黑潮......快来了，这一次极大可能会出现在西南边陲。
沉吟片刻，指尖重新开始无意识地敲击桌面，他下命令道。
“......等他回来。只要他能活着回来，证明了他的能力和运气，我便给他一个觐见的机会。“
“遵命。“下属躬身退下。
约定的日子转眼即至。
贫民窟，一座破旧3层木屋里。
林鬼收拾着远行需要的物品，将买来的物品整齐放进行囊后。
双手一顿，目光看向床下，一个上了锁的木箱。
叹气一声，将其拖出，解锁打开。
content_en:
Lin Gui did not expect that the store manager's commission was just the beginning.
When he shuttled to various stores to buy supplies for the trip.
The news that he had accepted the "Homing Pigeon" commission spread like wildfire throughout the streets and alleys.
People in the slums whispered to each other, their eyes shining with disbelief.
New Testament City, City Lord’s Mansion.
After listening to the detailed report of the subordinate.
The city lord, who was wearing brocade robes and tapping his fingertips on the expensive wooden table, frowned.
The candlelight in the study room flickered, reflecting his uncertain face.
"You mean, that wandering mage named Lin Gui went to the Magic City and escaped unscathed?"
There was a hint of disbelief in his voice.
Over the past ten years, the number of demons in the wild has increased dramatically.
It would be great if one out of ten guards and adventurers sent out to explore could come back.
Even the most powerful knight under his command could not pass through the Dark Forest outside New Testament City alone.
He claimed that he had to be escorted by an extraordinary person to barely be able to pass through.
How did he, a humble magician who started out as a street boy, do it?
And it’s a magical city thousands of miles away?
"It's absolutely true, Lord City Lord."
The subordinate replied respectfully.
"The Yongming Crystal Lamp that sold for a sky-high price at the auction a year ago was the one he brought back from the Magic City. The guard chief saw it with his own eyes."
The city lord's gaze passed over the magic lamp on the table that was emitting a soft and magnificent light. He paused at his fingertips and nodded slowly.
The lamp was indeed extraordinary, containing magical craftsmanship that would have fascinated the best blacksmiths in the New Testament.
"How is his strength assessed?"
"According to the observations of the Adventurer's Guild, he should be a high-level low-level mage, proficient in the elemental power of wind and earth."
"Strength... no one knows accurately because no one has seen him fight."
"According to my subordinates, he may be only half as good as the Commander of the Defense Corps."
"Oh?"
The city lord prolonged his tone and leaned forward slightly, showing interest.
A high-level mage who can compete with the leader is rare in the entire New Testament City.
"Do you need me to take someone with you and ask him to take over the task of escorting the young lady to Kalan City?"
The subordinate asked cautiously, deliberately emphasizing the word "please".
"Hmph."
The city lord let out a contemptuous snort from his nose.
"Entrusting my precious pearl to a wandering mage from a poor background? Absolutely impossible."
He paused. Even though the other person's background made him instinctively repulse him, his daughter's trip was indeed imminent.
For the continuation of their family, the marriage in Kalan City cannot be delayed any longer.
The Kuroshio...is coming soon, and this time it is very likely to appear in the southwest border.
After pondering for a moment, his fingertips began to tap the table unconsciously again, and he gave the order.
"...wait for him to come back. As long as he comes back alive and proves his ability and luck, I will give him a chance to meet."
"As ordered." The subordinate bowed and retreated.
The appointed day is coming in a blink of an eye.
In a slum, a dilapidated three-story wooden house.
Lin Gui packed up the items he needed for his journey and put the purchased items neatly in his bag.
He paused his hands and looked at a locked wooden box under the bed.
With a sigh, he dragged it out and unlocked it.
title_en: Chapter 3 An unexpected commission Chapter 4 The first stop is the Dark Forest
